raw.details:
Overview

Imagine. Innovate. Build What's Next.

About

NURN 2026 is an innovation-driven hackathon designed to bring together creative minds, aspiring developers, technology enthusiasts and student innovators from across India.

NURN provides a platform for participants to identify real-world problems, develop innovative solutions and transform their ideas into working prototypes.

Whether you are interested in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Web Development, App Development, Automation, Software Engineering or emerging technologies, NURN welcomes innovative ideas and practical solutions.

This is your opportunity to think beyond conventional boundaries, experiment with technology, collaborate with talented individuals and showcase your creativity.

What to Expect

Participants will get the opportunity to:

  • Work on innovative, real-world problem statements.
  • Explore Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.
  • Develop practical software solutions and prototypes.
  • Showcase technical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Compete with innovators from different institutions.
  • Receive recognition for outstanding projects.
  • Connect with fellow participants and the NURN community.

Hackathon Domains

Participants can explore projects in the following domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Generative AI & AI Agents
  • Web Development & Full-Stack Development
  • Mobile Application Development
  • Automation & Productivity Solutions
  • Software Engineering & SaaS
  • Data Science & Analytics
  • Cybersecurity & Digital Safety
  • IoT & Smart Technology
  • Open Innovation – Beyond Boundaries

Participants are encouraged to explore original ideas and meaningful applications of technology.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to college and university students.
  • Students from all academic disciplines are welcome.
  • Beginners and experienced developers can participate.
  • Team size: 1 member.
  • Inter-college teams are permitted, subject to the final registration rules.
  • Each participant can be part of only one team.

Process

Stage 1 – Registration

Register for NURN through the official Unstop opportunity. Complete your participant and team details accurately.

Stage 2 – Idea Submission

Participants submit their proposed project idea, problem statement, proposed solution, innovation and technical approach.

Stage 3 – Shortlisting

The evaluation team reviews submissions based on originality, relevance, feasibility and innovation. Shortlisted participants will be informed through official communication channels.

Stage 4 – Prototype Development

Shortlisted teams develop their proposed solutions into functional prototypes. Technical documentation, project demonstrations and supporting materials may be required.

Stage 5 – Final Evaluation

Selected finalists present and demonstrate their projects before the evaluation panel.

Stage 6 – Results & Recognition

Winners and outstanding participants will be recognised according to the announced awards and evaluation results.

Exact dates, submission instructions and round-specific requirements will be announced through official NURN communication channels.

Judging Criteria

Projects will be evaluated on:

  • Innovation & Originality
  • Technical Implementation
  • Problem-Solving Approach
  • Practical Feasibility
  • User Experience
  • Real-World Impact
  • Scalability
  • Presentation & Demonstration

Rules

  • All submissions must represent original work.
  • Impersonation and misrepresentation are prohibited.
  • Participants must provide accurate registration information.
  • A participant cannot register with multiple teams.
  • Participants must follow all submission deadlines.
  • AI tools and third-party resources may be used where permitted, but their use must be disclosed when requested.
  • Participants must respect intellectual property rights and applicable software licences.
  • Submitted project links and demonstrations must be accessible for evaluation.
  • Unprofessional behaviour, harassment or attempts to manipulate the evaluation process may result in disqualification.
  • Organisers reserve the right to reject incomplete or rule-violating submissions.
  • The judges' decisions will be final.

Join the WhatsApp group here: https://chat.whatsapp.com/FrqQ0vBIbWvEYvOde8vWjC

Joining the official NURN WhatsApp group is strongly required for every registered participant.

All important hackathon announcements, updates and communication will be shared through the official WhatsApp group.

Participants will receive information regarding:

  • Important event announcements.
  • Registration updates and confirmations.
  • Problem statement announcements.
  • Round-wise instructions and guidelines.
  • Submission deadlines and reminders.
  • Changes in the competition schedule.
  • Shortlisting and finalist announcements.
  • Results and certificate-related updates.
  • Important notices and other event-related information.

Important: After registering on Unstop, participants should join the WhatsApp group to stay informed throughout the hackathon. Please check the group regularly so that you do not miss important announcements or deadlines.

The official Unstop opportunity remains the primary registration and submission platform. The WhatsApp group is the official supplementary communication channel.

Awards

  • Outstanding participants will receive recognition based on their performance and the announced award structure.
  • Awards and certificates will be distributed according to the official event announcements.

Stay connected. Stay informed. Keep innovating.

YOUR IDEAS. YOUR INNOVATION. YOUR FUTURE.

Think Big. Build Bold. Make an Impact.
